items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I was wondering about Lorenzo's father, the old man Tio, and the Papa Tio.

ctx.x: It ain't the same. Well, your fingers done got all stiff and out of whack. Your lips done got bad. Your wind done got bad. You forget, you forget the breathing space that you would take on certain measures and passages. You see, you can take breathing space on certain passages and measures and just continue on through. Well, if you don't catch the right breathing space, you'll never make that passage all in one slur.
I was wondering about Lorenzo's father, the old man Tio, and the Papa Tio. Papa Tio was his uncle. Uncle.
